title: Leonardo da Vinci born near Vinci

where.name: Anchiano, near Vinci, Tuscany
where.note: Britannica gives Anchiano, near Vinci, as his birthplace.

summary: Leonardo da Vinci, painter, engineer and one of the defining figures of the Renaissance, was born at Anchiano near the Tuscan town of Vinci.
description: Leonardo was born on 15 April 1452 at Anchiano, near Vinci, in the Republic of Florence. His parents were not married: his father, Ser Piero da Vinci, was a Florentine notary and landowner.
He became a painter, draughtsman, sculptor, architect and engineer, and died on 2 May 1519 at Cloux (now Clos-Lucé) in France.
context: The town of Vinci is home to the Museo Leonardiano.

facts.text: Leonardo was born on 15 April 1452 at Anchiano, near Vinci.
His father, Ser Piero da Vinci, was a Florentine notary.

uncertain.text: The identity of his mother is not certain. Britannica says she was possibly Caterina di Meo Lippi, a young peasant woman, while a few scholars have suggested she was an enslaved woman from Asia.
